q.line: He swung his hammer brown and silver
stanza: Your daddy was a builder
He swung his hammer brown and silver
Every time he closed his eyes a nail was drove
And you were always underfoot
Like a splinter in the wood
He couldn't pull you from his heels

q.line: I don't need gold, don't need silver
stanza: I don't need gold, don't need silver
Just bread when I’m hungry
Fire when I’m cold
Don't need a ring for my finger
Just need a steady hand to hold
Don’t promise me fair sky above
Don't promise me kind road below
Just walk beside me, love
Any way the wind blows

partner.line: Don't need a ring for my finger

q.line: I know the killer, he counts my silver
stanza: The white dog of the farm still breeds
She's off her leash to tear flesh and teach
Bum, bum, bum
You think you've heard it all before
Well, here's once more, we're all at war
Bum, bum, bum
Blood in the streets, our eternal river
I know the killer, he counts my silver
Bum, bum, bum
They ambushed them behind the reeds
These are our seeds, white dog still breeds
Bum, bum, bum

partner.line: Blood in the streets, our eternal river

q.line: The moon rise up and turn to silver
stanza: Let me watch night fall on the river
The moon rise up and turn to silver
The sky move, the ocean shimmer
The hedge shake, the last living rose quiver

partner.line: Let me watch night fall on the river

q.line: Well you can fall for chains of silver
q.linePrev: As I was just another one of your deals?
q.lineNext: You can fall for chains of gold

stanza: With gold and silver
I would support her
But I'll sing no more now
Till I get a drink

q.line: For twenty-five dollars and pieces of silver
stanza: Oh, what have I done? Why have I done it?
I've committed a crime, broken the law
For twenty-five dollars and pieces of silver
I held up and robbed a hard liquor store

partner.line: Oh, what have I done? Why have I done it?

q.line: I heard her sing in tongues of silver
stanza: I heard her sing in tongues of silver
I heard her cry on a summer storm
I loved her, but she did not know it
So I don't think about her anymore
Now she's gone and I can't believe it
So I don't think about her anymore

partner.line: I loved her, but she did not know it

q.songTitle: The Island: Come and See; The Landlord’s Daughter; You’ll Not Feel the Drowning
q.line: "I'll take no gold miss, I'll take no silver
stanza: "I'll take no gold miss, I'll take no silver
But I'll take those sweet lips, and thou will deliver!"

partner.line: But I'll take those sweet lips, and thou will deliver!"
